interpretation_limits: These are teacher-forced cross-entropy losses on the training targets. Lower loss shows better fit to those targets under teacher forcing; it does not by itself establish free-generation quality, mathematical reasoning ability, or acquisition of a general method.
Old32 and continuation128 aggregate rows have different exposure counts. The exact-ID paired comparisons and full-dataset pass comparisons keep the example composition fixed.
This diagnostic contains no new evaluation outputs and does not score transfer or held-out tasks.
